# 2 Samuel 12 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Samuel 12 (31 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 12

---

## V.3 — "morsel" vs. "plate"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "morsel" / **PNEUMA:** "plate"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "morsel" — *mippitto* = from his morsel; PNEUMA modernizes away from the intimacy.

---

## V.4 — "traveler/wayfarer" vs. "visitor"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "traveler... wayfarer" / **PNEUMA:** "traveler... visitor"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "traveler... guest" — two distinct Hebrew words (*helekh*, *oreach*); "guest" captures *oreach* naturally.

---

## V.5 — "son of death" vs. "deserves to die"
- **EMET:** "son of death" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "deserves to die"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "deserves to die" — *ben-mavet* is an idiom; literal rendering is opaque in English.

---

## V.8 — "bosom" vs. "arms"
- **EMET:** "bosom" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "arms"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "arms" — *cheq* = bosom/lap/arms; "arms" is more natural.

---

## V.9 — "despised" vs. "treated with contempt"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "despised" / **PNEUMA:** "treated with contempt"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "despised" — more forceful for prophetic speech.

---

## V.13 — "put away" vs. "taken away" vs. "passed over"
- **EMET:** "passed over" / **LOGOS:** "put away" / **PNEUMA:** "taken away"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "put away" — *he'evir* = caused to pass over; "put away" preserves formal gravity.

---

## V.14 — *tiqqun soferim* — "enemies of the LORD" vs. direct
- **EMET:** preserves MT "enemies of YHWH" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "the LORD" (restore original)
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the LORD" — recognized *tiqqun soferim*; original reading restored.

---

## V.16 — "sought" vs. "pleaded" vs. "begged"
- **EMET:** "sought" / **LOGOS:** "pleaded" / **PNEUMA:** "begged"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "pleaded" — captures urgency without desperation.

---

## V.18 — "do evil" vs. "harm himself" vs. "something desperate"
- **EMET:** "do evil" / **LOGOS:** "do himself harm" / **PNEUMA:** "do something desperate"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "do himself harm" — fits the servants' fear for David's wellbeing.

---

## V.24 — Subject of "called his name"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "he called" (ambiguous) / **PNEUMA:** "David named him"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "he called" — Hebrew pronoun is ambiguous; do not specify David as subject.

---

## V.25 — Jedidiah meaning in-line
- **EMET:** in brackets / **LOGOS:** name only / **PNEUMA:** meaning in-line
- **SOPHIA ruling:** meaning in-line — "Jedidiah — 'beloved of the LORD'" — the name's theology is essential.

---

## V.31 — Forced labor vs. execution
- **EMET:** ambiguous / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** forced labor
- **SOPHIA ruling:** forced labor — MT *vayasem* (set/placed) supports labor, consistent with brick-kiln reference.

---
*— SOPHIA*
